parent_matrix.parent_name: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC)
parent_matrix.primary_source: J. Kirkpatrick, R. Pascanu, N. Rabinowitz, J. Veness, G. Desjardins, A. A. Rusu, K. Milan, J. Quan, T. Ramalho, A. Grabska-Barwinska, D. Hassabis, C. Clopath, D. Kumaran, R. Hadsell. 'Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks.' PNAS 114(13):3521-3526, 2017, doi:10.1073/pnas.1611835114; arXiv:1612.00796. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1612.00796
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [Atari results] 'While augmenting the DQN agent with EWC allows it to learn many games in sequence without suffering from catastrophic forgetting, it does not reach the score that would have been obtained by training ten separate DQNs.' [same section] 'it is therefore likely that the chief limitation of the current implementation is that it under-estimates parameter uncertainty.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: DQN+EWC over the published ten-game schedule with the ten-independent-DQN control at identical frame budget. ADAPTED: any continual learner retaining the ten-separate-systems ceiling as the subtraction baseline, since that ceiling is what the authors' own negative is defined against. The MNIST permutation demo is cheap but does NOT exhibit this negative.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: Atari ALE at the authors' frame budget (20M frames per game before EWC activation); the ten-independent-DQN control trained under the identical budget; the nullspace-perturbation probe is required to reproduce the uncertainty-underestimation finding.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: The authors report that EWC does not close the gap to independently trained networks: the EWC-augmented agent fails to reach the score of ten separately trained DQNs. They then diagnose their own mechanism, concluding that the chief limitation of their implementation is that it under-estimates parameter uncertainty.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: HOSTILE TEST for #277 section 7's comparison arms: CONTINUED_OCM must be measured against TASK_SPECIFIC_OCM (independent per-task systems), not only against RESET_OCM. A lineage that beats a reset baseline while losing to per-task systems has demonstrated retention, not amortization. Binds directly to H1_AMORTIZED_ACQUISITION and to the EV_RISES_DESCENDANTS_FALL family.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: The parent's own authors report it does NOT own the function at the per-task-system ceiling, so the function is not closed by this parent. The ORION-OCM delta is only plausible, not shown: #165 does not claim to beat a per-task-system ceiling either, and H1 is a CAPITAL NEGATIVE there.

parent_matrix.parent_name: Three scenarios for continual learning (EWC/SI under class-incremental conditions)
parent_matrix.primary_source: Gido M. van de Ven, Andreas S. Tolias. 'Three scenarios for continual learning.' arXiv:1904.07734, 15 Apr 2019; extended from a NeurIPS 2018 Continual Learning workshop paper. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1904.07734
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [Discussion] 'In this scenario, even for relatively simple task protocols involving the classification of MNIST-digits, regularization-based methods such as EWC and SI completely fail.' [authors' own hedge] 'It should be stressed that a limitation of the current study is that MNIST-images are relatively easy to generate.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: their three-scenario protocol (Task-IL / Domain-IL / Class-IL) on split and permuted MNIST with the same method set. ADAPTED: keep the three-scenario taxonomy as an evaluation harness and substitute the method - the taxonomy, not the method list, is the reusable organ.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: The load-bearing condition is scenario identity: a challenger claiming retention must be evaluated with NO task label at test time and a single shared output head. Compute is negligible; the checker is mean accuracy over all tasks seen.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: Regularization-based continual learning fails outright in the class-incremental scenario, that is, exactly when task identity must be inferred rather than supplied. The authors hedge their own positive replay result by noting MNIST images are easy to generate, so it remains open whether generative replay scales. THIRD-PARTY negative about EWC, not a claim by Kirkpatrick et al.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: TASK-IDENTITY LEAKAGE generalizes to QUERY-ROUTING LEAKAGE. If an ORION-OCM retention or reuse measurement supplies the method family, warrant class or task identity at query time, it is measuring the Task-IL analogue and not retention. Hostile test: re-run every H1/H2 retention claim with the family label withheld. Binds to MEASUREMENT_VALIDITY (M>=3 requires hostile families bounded) and to KN_FALLS_DEPENDENCIES_OMITTED.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: The failure is specific to gradient-regularization in a shared parameter vector. ORION-OCM's provenance-indexed store is a different mechanism, so the negative does not transfer automatically - but neither is the ORION side demonstrated, and #165 records H2/H3/H4 as PARENT_SUFFICIENT AT PLANTED SCOPE only.

parent_matrix.parent_name: Measuring Catastrophic Forgetting in Neural Networks
parent_matrix.primary_source: Ronald Kemker, Marc McClure, Angelina Abitino, Tyler L. Hayes, Christopher Kanan. 'Measuring Catastrophic Forgetting in Neural Networks.' AAAI-18; arXiv:1708.02072. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1708.02072
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [ABSTRACT] 'Our experiments on real-world images and sounds show that the mechanism(s) that are critical for optimal performance vary based on the incremental training paradigm and type of data being used, but they all demonstrate that the catastrophic forgetting problem has yet to be solved.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: their three paradigms across MNIST/CUB-200/AudioSet with the Omega metrics normalized against an offline upper bound. ADAPTED: retain the Omega normalization against an offline ceiling, which is what makes cross-dataset comparison meaningful, and substitute datasets.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: The authors state the fairness condition explicitly and it is the reusable organ: EWC must NOT be given previous-session validation data if the comparison models cannot have it. Model capacity must be held roughly equal; the authors flag their own capacity choice as a possible disadvantage to some methods.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: No existing mechanism solves catastrophic forgetting once evaluation moves off MNIST onto real images and sounds, and which mechanism wins is paradigm- and data-dependent. The authors also record their own information-matching decision: they withheld from EWC the stored validation data its creators used, so that all models had equal information access.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: P-COORDINATE DISCIPLINE, stated by a parent rather than by us: a strongest-parent subtraction is invalid if the parent is run at DEGRADED INFORMATION relative to the treatment. This is the exact hazard the schema's 'matched information/resources/checker access' clause names, and it cuts both ways - a parent handed less information than ORION-OCM produces a fake delta. Hostile test: every P>=3 claim must publish the information vector given to BOTH arms.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: This row's value is methodological rather than competitive: it constrains how any P coordinate in this programme may be raised, and it does not itself claim a function ORION-OCM wants.

parent_matrix.parent_name: Towards Robust Evaluations of Continual Learning (measurement critique)
parent_matrix.primary_source: Sebastian Farquhar, Yarin Gal. 'Towards Robust Evaluations of Continual Learning.' arXiv:1805.09733, 24 May 2018, rev. 26 Jun 2019, doi:10.48550/arXiv.1805.09733. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1805.09733
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [ABSTRACT] 'Experiments used in current continual learning research do not faithfully assess fundamental challenges of learning continually.' [SEC 6.2] 'When coresets are removed, VCL alone completely forgets old tasks' [SEC 6.3] 'The fact that they systematically hide shortcomings of prior-focused approaches suggests that the evaluations are inadvertently biasing research efforts in the field.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: single-headed Split MNIST and single-headed Split FashionMNIST with VCL, VCL+coreset, coreset-only, EWC and VGR. ADAPTED: adopt their five desiderata (cross-task resemblance; shared output head; no test-time task labels; single pass with one model carried forward; more than two tasks) as an acceptance gate on any method. The desiderata are the transferable organ.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: The subtraction is fair only single-headed with no test-time task label. By this paper's own argument, any gain measured multi-headed is not evidence. Compute is trivial; the checker is per-task accuracy after the full sequence.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: The field's standard evaluations are measurement artifacts: multi-headed output layers and permutation tasks conceal the failure of prior-focused methods. Under single-headed Split MNIST the same methods that succeed multi-headed completely forget. The authors state the evaluations are inadvertently biasing research effort.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: EVALUATION ARTIFACT HIDES PARENT FAILURE - and, symmetrically, hides OUR OWN failure. Hostile test: every ORION-OCM retention/reuse metric must be reported under its HARDEST admissible condition, and any metric that succeeds only under a permissive harness is capped at that harness in the claim ceiling. This is the closest external analogue to #277 section 3's whole programme and should be cited in MEASUREMENT_VALIDITY_V1 as prior art for the hostile-family method itself.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: For the function 'a discipline that decides when a continual-learning evaluation is admissible', this parent plausibly already owns it: the five desiderata are a complete, published, adoptable gate. Confirming this closes the corresponding measurement atom as a success terminal rather than as work - ORION-OCM should ADOPT and CITE the desiderata, not re-derive them.

parent_matrix.parent_name: ANIL / Rapid Learning or Feature Reuse? (MAML's inner loop ablated)
parent_matrix.primary_source: Aniruddh Raghu, Maithra Raghu, Samy Bengio, Oriol Vinyals. 'Rapid Learning or Feature Reuse? Towards Understanding the Effectiveness of MAML.' ICLR 2020; arXiv:1909.09157 v2, 12 Feb 2020. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1909.09157
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [SEC 3.2.1] 'We observe that even when freezing all layers in the network body, performance hardly changes. This suggests that the meta-initialization has already learned good enough features that can be reused as is, without needing to perform any rapid learning for each test time task.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: MAML on MiniImageNet 5-way 1-shot and 5-shot, then freeze contiguous blocks at test time against full inner-loop adaptation. ADAPTED: apply the freezing probe and representational-similarity analysis as a diagnostic to ANY system claiming rapid adaptation. The probe generalizes even where MAML does not.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: Both arms must share ONE meta-initialization, because the claim is about what the inner loop adds on top of a fixed initialization. Same seeds and architecture; checker is few-shot test accuracy plus per-layer representational similarity before and after the inner loop.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: The authors ablate away MAML's defining component - inner-loop adaptation of the network body - and find performance hardly changes. The signature mechanism is largely inert; the effect is attributed to feature reuse from the meta-initialization. THIRD-PARTY negative about MAML.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: THE CANONICAL PRIOR DEMONSTRATION THAT A SIGNATURE MECHANISM CAN BE INERT. This is the external precedent for #277 section 7's decisive causal test: knock out the exact inherited object claimed to cause the gain, and the advantage should disappear if attribution is correct. ANIL shows the knockout can leave performance untouched - meaning the headline mechanism was never load-bearing. Hostile test: ORION-OCM must run the ANIL-shaped ablation on its own inherited objects (library entries, warrants, cached methods) BEFORE attributing any lineage gain to them. Binds to the C coordinate (C>=3 requires a prospective knockout that flips the outcome) and to PRIMITIVE_PRESSURE_FALLS_KNOWLEDGE_HIDDEN_IN_MACROS.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: For the function 'a protocol that detects an inert claimed mechanism', this parent plausibly owns it outright. ORION-OCM should adopt the freezing/knockout probe rather than invent one. Success terminal candidate.

parent_matrix.parent_name: How to train your MAML (seed-level instability of MAML)
parent_matrix.primary_source: Antreas Antoniou, Harrison Edwards, Amos Storkey. 'How to train your MAML.' arXiv:1810.09502. Fetched: https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1810.09502
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [FIG 1 caption] 'One can see that 2 out of 3 seeds with the original strided MAML seem to become unstable and erratic, whereas all 3 of the strided MAML++ models seem to consistently converge very fast, to much higher generalization accuracy without any stability issues.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: train original strided MAML across at least three seeds and plot generalization accuracy PER SEED, not seed-averaged. ADAPTED: adopt per-seed variance reporting as an acceptance criterion for any adaptation claim.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: Multi-seed reporting is the load-bearing condition; a fair subtraction must publish the seed spread rather than the mean. Same backbone and inner-loop step count on both arms.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: Two of three random seeds of the original method become unstable and erratic. The parent's reported performance is not reliably attainable without the authors' modifications. THIRD-PARTY negative about MAML.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: AGGREGATE MEAN CONCEALS SEED-LEVEL NON-REPRODUCIBILITY. Hostile test: any ORION-OCM result reported as a mean over runs must also publish the per-seed spread, because a single-seed reproduction can silently land on the stable seed and miss the finding entirely. Binds to the R coordinate: E4 disjoint replication over new seeds is precisely the instrument that exposes this.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: Methodological constraint on the R coordinate rather than a competing claim on an ORION-OCM function.

parent_matrix.parent_name: NELL - Never-Ending Language Learning (precision decay)
parent_matrix.primary_source: A. Carlson, J. Betteridge, B. Kisiel, B. Settles, E. R. Hruschka Jr., T. M. Mitchell. 'Toward an Architecture for Never-Ending Language Learning.' AAAI 2010. Fetched: http://rtw.ml.cmu.edu/papers/carlson-aaai10.pdf
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [Discussion] 'Although NELL's ongoing learning allows it to extract more facts each day, the precision of the extracted facts declines slowly over time. In part this is due to the fact that the easiest extractions occur during early iterations, and later iterations demand more accurate extractors to achieve the same level of precision. However, it is also the case that NELL makes mistakes that lead to learning to make additional mistakes.' [TABLE 2, verified byte-exact by the centre lane] Iterations '1-22 23-44 45-66', Estimated Precision (%) '90 71 57', # Promotions '88,502 77,835 76,116'; caption: 'Note that the estimates of precision only consider beliefs promoted during a time period and ignore beliefs promoted earlier.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: not feasible. NELL depends on a 2010-era web crawl that is not distributable, and the checker is human-judged sampled precision. ADAPTED: a bootstrapped never-ending extractor over a FROZEN modern corpus snapshot with the same coupled multi-component design and the same sampled-precision-per-window measurement, so the decay curve stays comparable in shape even though absolute numbers cannot be.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: The human-feedback budget must be held constant across arms (see A08). Requires an adjudicator for sampled-belief precision, and precision must be measured over NEWLY promoted beliefs per window, since the authors' own estimates deliberately ignore earlier promotions.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: The authors report their own measured precision decay across iterations - 90 percent, then 71, then 57 for newly promoted beliefs - and concede a compounding-error mechanism in their own words: mistakes lead to learning to make additional mistakes. They further concede their components are not error-independent as designed.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: LINEAGE PRECISION DECAY UNDER SELF-TRAINING is the single most directly transferable negative for #151. A persistent lineage that accumulates its own outputs as evidence can raise volume while degrading the precision of what it newly admits, and a CUMULATIVE metric hides it. Hostile test: report precision of NEWLY admitted objects per epoch, never cumulative precision, and run a compounding-error probe that traces whether an admitted error caused subsequent admissions. Binds to EV_RISES_DESCENDANTS_FALL and BREMIND_FALLS_FALSE_ANALOGY_RISES.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: ORION-OCM's exact revocation and provenance machinery (H4, recorded PARENT_SUFFICIENT AT PLANTED SCOPE in #165) is precisely the organ NELL lacked - it has no exact retraction of a belief and its downstream descendants. That is a genuine delta organ, but it is unshown against this parent and #165 caps H4 at planted scope.

parent_matrix.parent_name: NELL - human-correction volume behind sustained precision
parent_matrix.primary_source: T. Mitchell, W. Cohen, E. Hruschka, P. Talukdar, et al. 'Never-Ending Learning.' AAAI 2015. Fetched: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~tom/pubs/NELL_aaai15.pdf. Journal version: Communications of the ACM 61(5):103-115, 2018, doi:10.1145/3191513 - CrossRef-confirmed for venue/volume/pages, full text NOT reachable (dl.acm.org 403). All quotes are from the AAAI 2015 paper actually fetched.
parent_matrix.quoted_line: [Empirical evaluation] 'of NELL's existence, it has averaged 2.4 negative feedbacks per predicate, per month, for a total of 85,088 items of negative feedback, or 1,467 per month.' 'This is likely to be the result of an abnormally high rate of human feedback to NELL during iterations 100 through 166, resulting in a temporary boost in accuracy. During these 67 iterations NELL received 31% of the total human feedback it has received over its 866 iterations.'
parent_matrix.faithful_vs_adapted: FAITHFUL: infeasible (multi-year live deployment with a human in the loop). ADAPTED: the human-feedback accounting is directly reusable as a cost metric - any lifelong system claiming sustained or improving precision reports its correction volume on the same per-predicate-per-month basis.
parent_matrix.matched_conditions: An explicit human-feedback budget is the fair-subtraction condition. NELL's improving precision is not a zero-supervision result, so a challenger must either match the correction rate or report precision at zero feedback.
parent_matrix.published_negative_results: The authors quantify their own dependence on human correction - 85,088 items of negative feedback, roughly 1,467 per month - and attribute an observed accuracy improvement to a feedback burst in which 31 percent of all lifetime human feedback arrived within 67 of 866 iterations. IMPORTANT CONTRAST WITH A07: in this later paper precision trends upward over time, so the 2010 decay was not permanent; the recovery is entangled with heavy human feedback.
parent_matrix.generalized_atom: THE EXTERNAL COGNITIVE INPUT LEDGER, VALIDATED BY PRIOR ART. NELL is the strongest published demonstration that an apparent autonomy result can be carried by unlogged human correction, and that a capability curve can bend upward from a supervision burst rather than from learning. Hostile test for #277 section 4 / TTAC-D5: plot every ORION-OCM capability curve against the contemporaneous external-input volume on the same time axis, and treat any improvement coincident with an input burst as unattributed until the ledger separates them. Binds to the A coordinate, which gates the sentence and not merely the number.
parent_matrix.verdict_reasoning: For the function 'how to account for external human cognition inside a never-ending learner's reported capability', NELL's per-predicate-per-month accounting plausibly already owns it. ORION-OCM's EXTERNAL_COGNITIVE_INPUT_LEDGER should adopt this accounting shape and cite it, rather than invent a private one. Success terminal candidate and a direct input to TTAC-D5.
